verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The one-word-per-line headline takes up about 60% of the skyscraper, so the plan cards shrink to tiny tiles with unreadable labels. The cards are also out of order (Monthly, Family, Yearly instead of Monthly, Yearly, Family), and the CTA comes before the plans and the subhead. A is worse because its pacewell logo is shrunk to an illegible speck. B keeps the logo a readable size, though it sits cramped against the headline.
